description: GUI Windows service manager with searchable inventory, previewed changes, service history, and configuration-drift snapshots.
notes: This manifest installs the official self-contained x64 GUI ZIP; it does not run the vendor MSI installer. The archive is extracted from its BetterWindowsServices folder.
The launcher redirects APPDATA to the persisted data\Roaming folder, keeping bws-preferences.json in Scoop's persistent data directory across updates.

The WPF single-file executable extracts native runtime libraries outside the Scoop directory: under %TEMP% without elevation and under %ProgramData%\BetterWindowsServices when elevated. The elevated location is protected by an application-enforced ACL and may remain after uninstall; this runtime behavior is why the manifest is classified Nonportable.
Windows 10 version 1809 or Windows Server 2019 and later, x64. Reading service information does not require elevation; applying service changes requires an elevated session.
